value.title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection & Parser Hardening Methodology
value.content: {"id": "portswigger_xxe", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "xxe", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection", "name": "XML External Entity (XXE) Injection & Parser Hardening Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-611", "owasp_category": "A05:2021 - Security Misconfiguration", "signals": ["content_type_xml", "xml_in_post_body", "soap_endpoint", "svg_upload", "entity_resolution_error", "xinclude_feature_enabled"], "verification_strategy": "Transmit safe XML payloads declaring standard internal entities (e.g. <!ENTITY test 'probe'>) to confirm entity expansion without requesting external network resources. For blind XXE, check for parser exceptions or OOB DNS interaction through safe callback listeners.", "evidence_requirements": ["entity_expansion_reflection", "parser_doctype_error", "content_type_delta"], "tools": [{"tool": "WebTools (Safe XML Probe)", "cmd": "WebTools.probe_xml_entity(url, body)", "desc": "Constructs benign XML entity declarations testing parser resolution"}, {"tool": "nuclei (XXE Templates)", "cmd": "nuclei -u url -t /nuclei-templates/http/vulnerabilities/generic/xxe-probe.yaml", "desc": "Differential XML parsing detection without external exfiltration"}], "remediation": "Completely disable external entity resolution (DTD processing) in XML parsers (e.g. setFeature('http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl', True)). Use modern data formats like JSON wherever feasible.", "description": "PortSwigger XXE labs cover retrieving system files via file://, exploiting SSRF via XXE, blind XXE using out-of-band techniques, repurposing local DTD files to trigger error messages, and abusing XML parsers in image (SVG) uploads."}
